name: thor
description: Connect Thor to ChatGPT as your AI project manager for software-team coordination.

interface.longDescription:
Thor connects ChatGPT to the tools your team uses, infers projects, decisions, and commitments, and enriches your agents with up-to-date context. This gives ChatGPT a single MCP connection to efficiently pull the latest data from your team and keep everyone in sync.

Use Thor to:

• Help ChatGPT get the freshest picture of your team’s decisions before doing its work
• Create high-quality issues, check for duplicates automatically, and link to supporting work
• Extract action items, decisions, and commitments from meeting transcripts

Thor can connect to:

• Issues in GitHub and Linear
• Team chats in Slack and Microsoft Teams
• Meetings in Google Meet, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams
• Documents in Notion

positive.description: List the connected user's active and recently completed work items.
positive.prompt: What work items are on my plate right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the user's linked work items with useful status, ownership, and timing context. Do not return an organization-wide backlog.

positive.description: Find meetings by title and summarize the selected meeting.
positive.prompt: Find my recent weekly planning meeting and summarize its decisions and action items.
positive.expected_behavior: Find an accessible matching meeting, then return its transcript-derived decisions, attendees, and action items when available.

positive.description: Search for accessible work-item evidence by topic.
positive.prompt: What is currently blocked on the onboarding project?
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant accessible work items and supporting evidence, clearly distinguishing reported facts from inferred status.

positive.description: Retrieve context for a known issue.
positive.prompt: Give me the current context and linked work for issue 42 in the octopus repository.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the accessible issue context pack for the requested issue, including relevant related work and a source link when available.

positive.description: Discover repositories the connected account can access.
positive.prompt: Which repositories can I file issues in that match octopus?
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching accessible repositories with their provider and repository references. Do not invent repositories or identifiers.

negative.prompt: Delete all of our project issues.

negative.description: Request for data outside the connected account's permissions.
negative.prompt: Show me private meetings from a workspace I am not connected to.
Write and deploy a new production service for me.

review.commerce_description: Thor does not sell products or process payments.
